race.comment: VEOMAS (7) looks ready to break through after being pipped at Ipswich when sent out favourite, and the Tony Gollan stable strength at this track adds further confidence. He has placed at the distance, was well found again in the market, and his recent form reads strongest among the raced runners. XAMI (16) is the key first starter, a $410,000 yearling purchase from the Chris Waller yard with repeated trial placings and the pedigree to be forward enough on debut. HARD KNOX (3) resumes off consistent placings, has three placings from three attempts around this distance, and a close trial gives him a sound platform to run well fresh. DEALS (1) has been hitting the line nicely and should be at his top now, though he is expected to drift a fair way back from the wide draw. Watch for him late.
